# Primitive and literal conformance matrix

Exercises declarations and expressions, widening, `as const`, `satisfies`,
enum-like values, imports, contextual values, literal unions, and null-like
values through the shared Go-oracle and independent Rust/OXC shadow path.

The enum-like value and both imported literals are stable regression fixtures,
not denominator exclusions. Their manifest entries pin an unsupported code,
the owning migration category, and the concrete implementation needed before
each selection may be reclassified as supported.
